overview_description.description:
PING designs, manufactures, and distributes golf equipment and accessories. The company’s product portfolio includes drivers, fairway woods, hybrids, irons, wedges, putters, carry and cart bags, custom fittings, headwear, on-course gear, travel gear, gloves, and more for men and women. It also offers repair services for golf clubs and distributes its products through 
its network of retailers and online store.


PING was founded by Karsten Solheim in 1959 and is based in Phoenix, Arizona.

about_short_description.short_description: PING designs, manufactures, and distributes golf equipment, apparel, and accessories.

product.name: G440 Driver Family
product.description: A set of golf drivers designed to increase ball speed and forgiveness with optimized center of gravity and longer shafts.

product.name: G440 Fairways
product.description: Fairway woods with redesigned face and low center of gravity for high-launching shots and confidence off the tee.

product.name: G440 Hybrids
product.description: Hybrid clubs with varied ball-flight characteristics and a low center of gravity for higher launch and increased ball speed.

product.name: G440 Irons
product.description: Distance-focused irons with a thin face and cavity-back design for higher launch, forgiveness, and consistent greens hits.

product.name: i240 Irons
product.description: Players model irons combining high launch, added forgiveness, and control for consistent approach shots.

product.name: iDi Driving Iron
product.description: Driving iron with optimized lofts and forged face for improved distance, control, and sound.
